title: basic-auth admin bootstrap: initial admin password comes only from MLFLOW_AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD or admin_password, never a shipped default
answers: Why does mlflow server --app-name basic-auth refuse to start without an admin password?
Where do I set the initial admin username and password for basic auth in Docker or Kubernetes?
Does basic auth still ship a default admin credential such as password1234?
Why does the basic-auth server exit with one error instead of restart-looping when the admin password is missing?
Can I change the admin username created on first start of the basic-auth app?
body:
Path: First-start creation of the basic-auth admin user, reached from the `mlflow server` CLI via `mlflow/server/__init__.py:_bootstrap_basic_auth` and from each worker's `create_app`. Inputs are the admin username and password from `mlflow/server/auth/config.py:read_auth_config`, which reads `MLFLOW_AUTH_ADMIN_USERNAME` / `MLFLOW_AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD` or the `admin_username` / `admin_password` keys of the basic_auth.ini or the file named by `MLFLOW_AUTH_CONFIG_PATH`.
Rule: Never ship or default an admin password. `read_auth_config` lets a set env var win even when empty (empty normalizes to None). `mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_validate_bootstrap_admin_password` rejects a missing, under-12-character or `password1234` password and names both fixes; `_validate_bootstrap_admin_username` rejects an empty username. `bootstrap_admin_user` runs in the CLI process before workers spawn, so a failure exits once instead of crash-looping the uvicorn supervisor.
Symptom: On a default basic-auth install the admin account was created with the publicly documented password `password1234` (GHSA-gq3w-7jj3-x7gr), reachable by anyone on the network. Separately, a missing admin password made every worker crash and the supervisor restart them forever.
Constraints: Applies only to `--app-name basic-auth`; the default app does not bootstrap. Values are used only to create the admin when it does not exist yet; later restarts ignore them except for the legacy-password rotation described in the sibling note. Needs the `auth` extra. Passwords must satisfy the store password policy (12+ characters).
applies: Startup of `mlflow server --app-name basic-auth` and the admin username/password inputs (env vars, basic_auth.ini, MLFLOW_AUTH_CONFIG_PATH).
says: Server with basic authentication enabled refuses to start without an administrator password.
Default administrator credentials no longer work on a fresh authenticated server installation.
Server startup fails when the administrator password has fewer than twelve characters.
Configure initial administrator credentials when deploying the authenticated server in containers.
Authenticated server exits with an error instead of continuously crash looping.
search: Startup configuration for mlflow server --app-name basic-auth requires an explicit admin password from MLFLOW_AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD or basic_auth.ini and never defaults to shipped credentials. The CLI bootstraps the admin user via mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_validate_bootstrap_admin_password before spawning workers, rejecting missing values, passwords under 12 characters, and the legacy password1234. Applies only to first-start creation under --app-name basic-auth with the auth extra installed, exiting cleanly on validation failure rather than crash-looping uvicorn worker processes.
